reviews.author: Viola Marqeni
reviews.text: Hï Ibiza is much more than just a disco: it is a total sensory experience, a temple of electronic music that has redefined the concept of nightlife.

reviews.author: Zlatko Mahic
reviews.text: HI IBIZA: A Great Club, But Prepare for Crowds and High Prices. Top-notch production and an incredible atmosphere — staff and security were a perfect 10/10.

reviews.author: Kirk Grimsley
reviews.text: Hi has amazing positive energy all over. You can move from room to room to experience different DJs, each room having its own vibe.
